text:
Maya (CS): Quick ask — can we set up a short series of 30-min drop-in enablement sessions for Acme's rollout next week? Need to cover onboarding gaps, a mini canary training, and a way to capture feedback / renewal signals.

Ethan (Solutions): +1. I can run a 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Suggest 3 days: Tue/Wed/Fri, 30m each. Proposed times: 11:00am PT / 7:00pm CET / 9:00am SGT (APAC option). Thoughts?

Diego (AM): FYI Acme asked for morning APAC ideally. Priya, is SGT 9am doable for them? Also flag: they showed some renewal hesitation last quarter — let's make sure we capture CSAT and blockers.

Priya (Acme PM): SGT 9am is okay for a few folks. Tue is best. Can we make Tue a deeper config walkthrough and Fri a lighter Q&A drop-in? Also please include a short form to collect post-session confidence + blockers.

Alex (Enablement): Sounds good. Draft agenda for the Tue deep session: 

```
Agenda (Tue 30m - deep)
- 0-5m: quick intros + desired outcomes
- 5-15m: config walkthrough (keys, routing, model pinning)
- 15-25m: live demo of typical errors + recovery patterns
- 25-30m: capture top blockers + next steps
```

For Wed/Thu drop-ins (15-30m) we can do 10m recap + 15m hands-on trouble-shooting.

Maya (CS): Can someone make a short Google form for post-session feedback? Fields: session date, confidence (1-5), top blocker, interested in follow-up (yes/no). Put link in the invite.

Ethan (Solutions): I'll whip one up. Link placeholder: https://forms.goo.gl/ACME-enablement (will update before invites)

OnboardBot: Reminder — upload pre-reads to the "Acme/Enablement" Drive folder and tag with `@acme-team` so members see it.

Priya (Acme PM): I'll drop the list of integration questions and sample logs to the Drive by EOD today. Pls add a note if you want us to anonymize any data.

Diego (AM): Action items: Maya to send calendar series with all timezone options, Ethan to create form + demo deck, Alex to prepare config snippets, Priya to upload questions. Also — can we add a short renewal check-in slot in the Fri session? 5m at the end to confirm health signals.

Maya (CS): Yep — adding a 5m renewal check-in to Fri. I'll target Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 SGT for the deep session (which is Mon 2026-04-06 11:00 PT). Sending invites after Ethan posts the form + deck.

Ethan (Solutions): PvP note: demo will include this snippet for quick repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"r-instruct-1","prompt":"hello"}'`

Alex (Enablement): I'll prepare a 1-slide checklist for the renewal check: usage trends, top 3 blockers, outstanding implementation tickets. Good to surface in Friday's 5m.

Priya (Acme PM): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything changes, ping me here.

Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll follow up once invites + form + deck are live. :thumbsup:

OnboardBot: Calendar series created: Acme Enablement Drop‑ins (3 events). Link: https://calendar.example.com/acme-enablement
